prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Greenvale Metro: underground/surface; peak/off-peak/engineering-hours. Communications-Based Train Control(CBTC): separation/authority/headway/dwell/recovery; protection constrains regulation. Line Traffic Controller requests service/regulation; Revenue Train Operator handles readiness/passengers/instructions/acknowledgements; field staff support fallback. Signal Maintenance Engineer(Maple) verifies/records clearance before post-anomaly restoration. Maintenance Diagnostic Server(Quarry): non-vital diagnostics; records route outcomes/point timing/detection transitions; no vital decisions/bypass. Cyber Security Officer manages access/incidents/keys; Cryptographic Key Management Appliance supplies onboard/path-authentication material; no safety-logic changes. Metro Operations Control System(Lantern) sends Crew Login Token Bundle; displays positions/regulation/alarms/commands/radio supervision; separately displays commanded/locked routes, points, occupancy. Service Timetable Server/Passenger Information Gateway: isolated non-vital schedules/information/approved messages. Voice Dispatch Console: degraded coordination, no safety-data substitute. North District Zone Controller(Marble)/South District Zone Controller(Orchid): main-lines/turnbacks/approaches; derive authorities from location/occupancy/equipment. East Junction Interlocking(Falcon)/West Junction Interlocking: final vital points/locking/routes/releases; send status/indications to zones/onboard. Authority requires approach consistency, overlap/flank/conflict protection, detected/locked/proved points. Correspondence loss shortens/withdraws authority within safe-braking envelope. Axle-counter clear/occupied independently evidences availability/locking; location conflicts use restrictive state. East sends Axle Counter Reset Request; degraded reset prohibited with locked routes/approaching trains. West sends Route Release Exception List for timed-release failures; zones retain hazard until path excluded. Boundaries: route/points/vacancy, not chainage; transfer needs odometer-confirmed position, receiving-zone validation/reissue. Mismatches withhold/shorten authority. Atlas Onboard Controller(Kestrel): authenticated power/integrity; initialization/protected-manual/automatic-train-operation/fallback/cutout; token-validates context; validates authorities; enforces speed/authority/doors/commands, cyclewise braking; produces Brake Curve Checksum Log. Dual Channel Odometer divergence increases uncertainty/preserves separation. Propulsion/brake interface isolated; assurance checks feedback/pressure/deceleration. Operator interface rejects stale/inconsistent acknowledgements. Platform Screen Door Controller sends closed-and-locked to wayside; berth

New part:
S101: The Operations Control Centre workflow begins with the Line Traffic Controller maintaining a live view of train positions, route status, alarms, and service performance across the Greenvale Metro line.
S102: The Metro Operations Control System presents regulating options based on timetable variance, platform dwell time, headway spacing, and the current availability of routes.
S103: The Line Traffic Controller selects holding, skip-stop, turnback, or run-through measures only after checking that passenger impact and downstream recovery have been assessed.
S104: Lantern displays the proposed regulating action, affected train identities, and predicted recovery time before the Line Traffic Controller confirms the command.
S105: The North District Zone Controller applies movement authority constraints according to the confirmed operating state and reports any conflict or unavailable route condition for controller review.
S106: The South District Zone Controller applies the same operating principles for the southern section while preserving separation margins and route locking conditions.
S107: East Junction Interlocking holds the route locked until track section detection, point correspondence, and opposing route conditions meet the configured release criteria.
S108: West Junction Interlocking provides route state indications that allow the Operations Control Centre to distinguish an operational delay from a signalling equipment fault.
S109: When an engineering possession or field report requires a temporary operating constraint, the Line Traffic Controller produces the Temporary Speed Restriction Notice after confirming the limits, speed value, start time, and expected removal condition.
S110: After a temporary operating constraint is active, the Line Traffic Controller monitors actual train performance against the expected delay allowance and adjusts regulation plans when recovery margins are exceeded.
S111: The Atlas Onboard Controller enforces the active movement profile on each equipped train and presents any onboard rejection or degraded mode indication for operational assessment.
S112: The Dual Channel Odometer supports train position confidence by providing independent distance measurement inputs that are considered during degraded operation review.
S113: The Train Radio Modem supports continuous operational messaging, and loss of radio availability is treated as a service risk that may require holding trains before constrained areas.
S114: The Wayside Radio Access Network is monitored for coverage alarms, handover irregularities, and capacity conditions that could affect the stability of train control communications.
S115: The Safety Data Communication Network is monitored as a safety-related bearer, and persistent communication faults are escalated before additional regulating actions are attempted in the affected area.
S116: For incident management, the Line Traffic Controller records the initial event time, train identifier, location, passenger impact, and the first safe operating instruction issued.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
